title: Payout Methods Transfer Fees: Desk Reference and Booking Tool
content:
Each transfer to one of a host's Payout Methods carries one transfer fee, booked as a transfer fee against the method it was sent to and naming the transfer; each transfer fee is computed on the transfer it names.

## When the transfer fee falls due

The transfer fee falls due on the transfer's settlement day, the rail's processing time in business days on the business-day calendar (the US Federal Reserve holiday calendar) after it was sent, or, for a transfer returned before it settles, on the day of the return. It is booked once per transfer, whether the transfer settled or came back.

| Hypothetical transfer | Sent | What became of it | Transfer fee falls due |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH), 5 business days | Monday 2026-07-13 | Settled | Monday 2026-07-20, the settlement day |
| International Wire Transfer, 7 business days | Monday 2026-07-13 | Settled | Wednesday 2026-07-22, the settlement day |
| International Wire Transfer, 7 business days | Monday 2026-07-13 | Returned on Thursday 2026-07-16, before it settled | Thursday 2026-07-16, the day of the return |

## Effect of booking

Once booked, the transfer fee stands on the method's ledger as its own entry, naming the transfer, and is taken out of the method's undisbursed balance, which drops by exactly the fee. Nothing else on the method or on the transfer changes. The host sees the fee as its own line in the payout history and on the next earnings statement.

## Booking tool: `book_transfer_fee_e67ff494`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool posts the transfer fee a payout rail charges for sending a transfer, whether the transfer settled or came back. One call adds one fee entry of kind `transfer_fee` to the payout method's ledger, dated today, naming the transfer it belongs to and carrying the amount given.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_transfer_fee_e67ff494` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_method_id` | The reference number of the payout method the transfer was sent to, exactly as returned by the payout-method lookup | Id |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the transfer record (a payout sent to the method) that the fee belongs to, exactly as shown by the payout ledger lookup | Id |
| `amount` | The transfer fee as a positive USD amount, already rounded as the fee policy prescribes | Fixed format, 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places and never changed otherwise |

**Return.** A text rendering of a record with `payout_txn_id` (the reference number of the new fee entry), `payout_method_id` (the method charged), `source_event_id` (the transfer the fee belongs to), `fee_type` (always `transfer_fee`), `amount` (the USD fee booked, 2 decimal places), `posted_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `status`. The call has succeeded when `status` comes back as "booked".
